value.rationale: A natural joint geometric invariant—dependence between volume and surface area of one random zonotope—has an exact all-sample-size law, a strictly monotone approach to perfect correlation, and a nonzero orthogonal residual measuring dependence not explained linearly by area. Its exact coefficient and decomposition are not implied by separately knowing the two marginal distributions and provide reusable cross-functional structure rather than an arbitrary numerical slice.
